text:
lieu: Design quickie: propose an "autocollapse" mode for preflight when many probes return OK so users can focus on failures. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/new/preflight-autocollapse (frame: condense). comments?
pras: Love the intent. concern: users might miss transient failures if we hide too aggressively. we need a clear summary and an affordance to expand all.
ida: Accessibility must be first: summary banner should be `role="status"` with `aria-live="polite"` announcing counts like "6 of 12 checks passing". do not announce each probe line.
omar: Copy suggestions: banner: "Network checks — 6 of 12 passing"; collapsed hint: "4 hidden, expand to view"; action: `Show all` / `Show failures`. shorter verbs please.
lieu: Implementation note: autocollapse kicks in when >4 probes. below that show compact list. also add a persistent failure pill so a failing host is always surfaced even when collapsed.
pras: For keyboard users, the expand control must be focusable and pressing Enter should open and focus first failing row. Escape collapses back and returns focus to toggle.
ida: Color contrast: dimmed OK text must still meet 4.5:1 or use a secondary icon + full-contrast text on hover/focus. also ensure icons have text alternatives.
omar: Mobile: expand affordance needs to be full-width and have 44px min height. also avoid tiny chevrons only targets.
lieu: UX microcopy I'll propose: banner: "Network checks — 6 of 12 passing"; collapsed hint: "4 hidden — Show failures"; expand CTA: "Show all"; tooltip for flaky: "Intermittent — 2/3 recent checks".
pras: Add an unobtrusive retry action on failures: `Retry` icon-only with accessible label `aria-label="Retry probe for host x"`. keep it after details toggle in DOM.
ida: Screen reader note: when the panel expands, announce "Expanded network checks, 4 hidden now visible" and move focus into the first failure using `aria-activedescendant` patterns.
ux-bot: Checklist added: aria-live on summary, persistent failure pill, keyboard focus flow for expand/collapse, contrast >=4.5:1, mobile tap target >=44px, icon labels.
lieu: I'll update figma and push a short PR with copy strings + accessible spec. tagging @pras @ida for final confirm. thanks! :sparkles:
